There were actually 12 cards per pack: 2 from the uncommon card
sheet, 4 from the vampire card sheet, and 6 from the common card
sheet.
> >
> > 45 packs per box.

> WhooHoo, so there should be, theoretically, 45 Rares, Yes?

Not exactly. This was what Ian and I were going on about. The
"rares" in Ancient Hearts were actually printed on the uncommon
sheet - along with the uncommons. There are 37 "rares", each of
which was printed twice on the uncommon sheet and 24 "uncommons",
each of which was printed five times (if I've counted the rares
and uncommons correctly). Add one incidence of Marijava Ghoul,
and there's a total of 195 cards on the uncommon sheet (37 X 2
plus 24 X 5 plus 1). Marijava Ghoul was also printed twice on
the vampire cardsheet and thus does not turn out to be rarer than
the rares.

Anyway, the upshot was that the 37 rares show up 74/195 of the
time in an uncommon cards slot, the 24 rares show up 120/195 of
the time, and the Marijava Ghoul turns up 1/195 of the time. Not
worrying about the latter, that gives you approximately
(45 * 74) / 195 or approximately 17 rares - but it varies.

Fred
